title: Stale
description: Why a read reply is not current. A reply that carries current carries stale if and only if current is false.

reason.description: cached: answered from the add-on's mirror. cooldown: a fresh read was asked for inside the cooldown. unreachable: the target could not be read. draining: the add-on is not accepting work. never_read: nothing has been read since the add-on started.

retry_after.description: Seconds until a fresh read may succeed, mirroring the Retry-After header.

note.description: A sentence for a person, in the add-on's words.

Invariant.description: current == false if and only if stale is present. Referenced by every reply that carries current.
